comments.body: Epic complete: 19/19 children closed, every change through Gerrit (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1) and merged to main. AC evidence by line: (1) detected-by provenance at creation + bug_trends metrics lens landed (creation-seam capture, zero new required user input). (2) Deterministic pre-LLM gates live in CI/store: raw-git-write gate (d37e, 6739ea54fa), unread-config-field detection, wall-clock-assert gate (1e95, 9af88c3ada), AC-checkbox completeness close precheck (433c) with 330c box-flip normalization. (3) Transport typed end-to-end; declared asymmetries pinned by property tests; pagination deduplicated into the shared cursor iterator (ab7f, 30c522cde9). (4) reconcile-bridge/canary workflow bodies, probe harness, vote normalizer migrated to Python per strangler-fig. (5) Canary bug filing uses hardened dedup + documented bug-creation contract; dedup-key normalization fixed under a32a (1329). (6) Engine-layer validation placement advisory-enforced via project criterion in plan review. (7) rebar-debug + rebar-implement skills and the shared test-design standard encode the approved discipline upgrades. (8) review-plan on bugs runs a real review; Gerrit bugfix-size backstop blocks oversized unreviewed bug fixes (B2, 4527/de0deb0c89) — live-calibrated on 5 historical fixtures (4b54 attestation). (9) Comment-hygiene remediation landed with CI guard (b047). Post-epic bug dispositions: a32a/d32b/cabc closed with class + evidence; 05cb/18a4 reasoned deferrals (pre-existing, not epic deliverables); ee2a (gate skew regression caused by d37e+1e95 gates) fixed + closed (1338, 52cd34f169). Follow-ups filed: 51c1 (330c doc gap).

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

A 344-bug corpus analysis (session log 5eb0-52a3-45f0-43e5) identified recurring escape channels: surface-parity gaps, contention semantics missed at authoring time, inert/miswired config, wall-clock flakes, unlocked store writes, auto-filer breakage, prose-only provenance rotting in code comments, and bug fixes landing without plan review. Each child was individually design-reviewed and approved by the operator (decision table in the session log; per-change experiments under /tmp/exp*.py referenced in child descriptions).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Bug provenance is observable at creation (detected-by) and trend-queryable (bug_trends metrics lens), without new required user input.
- [x] Deterministic pre-LLM gates exist for: raw git writes bypassing the store seam, unread config schema fields, upper-bound wall-clock asserts in tests, unchecked AC checkboxes at close, historical-context rot in code comments, and oversized bug-fix diffs lacking a current plan-review attestation.
- [x] The reconciler transport is typed end-to-end, declared field asymmetries are pinned by property tests, and pagination loops are deduplicated into shared iterators.
- [x] Production shell logic (reconcile-bridge/canary workflow bodies, probe harness, vote normalizer) is migrated to Python per the strangler-fig policy.
- [x] Canary/automation bug filing follows the hardened dedup pattern and a documented bug-creation contract.
- [x] Engine-layer validation placement is advisory-enforced at plan review.
- [x] rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills (and the shared test-design standard) encode the approved discipline upgrades: ticket writebacks, two-axis invariant sweeps, surface census, config-effect contrast, case-(c) contention triggers, gate-finding oracle upgrades, and residual-gap disposition.
- [x] Explicit review-plan on a bug runs a real review, and the Gerrit backstop blocks oversized bug fixes lacking one.
- [x] Code comments citing dead SHAs/run-ids/dates are remediated to ticket citations, with a CI guard preventing regression.
